# Composition Checklist: ISK-0006 — Host Composition & DI Registration

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for registration, module composition, service lifetimes, static state, and disposal are complete, clear, and consistent
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Registration and Modules

- [x] CHK001 - Is every registration method listed with its assembly, module name, sections, and required modules in one table, consistent across contract, research, and data model? [Consistency, Contract §Registration 6, Research R4, Data model §Modules]
- [x] CHK002 - Is "any order" defined together with the point at which order-dependent checks run? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Research R8, Contract §Known limits]
- [x] CHK003 - Is how a missing `AddIskender(...)` is detected, when nothing of Hosting's runs, specified? [Completeness, Research R8, Data model §CompositionCheck]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the rule that no assembly is scanned stated, along with what makes a module present in a container? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Research R3]
- [x] CHK005 - Are the two PostgreSQL opt-ins, and what persistence alone composes, specified? [Completeness, Spec §TR-5, §US5-6]
- [x] CHK006 - Is duplicate detection defined by module name and by coordinator kind, separately from ISK-0003's duplicate-namespace rule? [Clarity, Research R9, Contract §Registration mistakes]
- [x] CHK007 - Are the host-owned services Iskender never registers listed, each with its fallback when the host registers none? [Completeness, Contract §Registration 8, Research R12]

## Lifetimes

- [x] CHK008 - Does every Iskender service have exactly one stated lifetime and owner? [Completeness, Contract §Lifetimes, Spec §TR-6]
- [x] CHK009 - Are TR-6's "no transient unless stateless" and the contract's "none is transient" consistent? [Consistency, Spec §TR-6, Contract §Lifetimes 1]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the set of registration combinations that must pass container validation defined, including combinations with a registration mistake? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Contract §Lifetimes 2]
  - Settled in `checklist`: a combination with a missing `AddIskender(...)` or an unmet requirement must also build with validation on, so the mistake surfaces as its code at start (US5-2, US5-5), not as a container error. Contract Lifetimes rule 2 and task T041 say so.
- [x] CHK011 - Is how `GatewayExecutionContext` is reachable only within its request, and the failure outside one, specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Lifetimes 4]
- [x] CHK012 - Is it stated that one service collection built into two containers yields two independent snapshots? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Lifetimes 5]

## Static State

- [x] CHK013 - Are the allowed classes of static field defined precisely enough that a reflection scan decides each field mechanically? [Measurability, Contract §Static state, Research R11]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the telemetry-instrument exception justified, recorded as a maintainer decision, and its consequence stated as a known limit? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications 2026-11-14, Contract §Known limits]
- [x] CHK015 - Is each listed field given a reason, and is the rule that a field holding state is fixed and never listed stated? [Clarity, Contract §Static state]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the static fields known to need fixing named, with a fix that changes no frozen signature? [Completeness, Research R11, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK017 - Is it stated what the scan cannot see, and how that residue is covered? [Coverage, Contract §Known limits "Reflection scan"]

## Disposal

- [x] CHK018 - Is "nothing Iskender started outlives the container" defined for each thing Iskender starts, the guard's timer and lease and the per-data-source meter? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Research R10, R11]
- [x] CHK019 - Is double disposal, by host stop and then container disposal, defined as safe? [Edge Case, Research R10]
- [x] CHK020 - Is SC-006 measurable for each of its three parts: unlisted fields, validation errors, and shared contexts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
